contract.farms: two public farms; shed, seeds, and worker inventories private per player
contract.market: one shared inventory/price state; equal queue positions quote pre-commit then commit one unit per player
contract.processing_order: player actions, market queues, town demand, observation refresh, farm update
contract.score: terminal bank money; relative rank descending by money
contract.source: Kaggle kaggriculture environment README/json, package version 0.1.0
contract.worker_resources: farmer and hands consume one player-shared seed pool; inventories remain per worker

opponent_policy.information_boundary: public farm cash/workers/tiles and shared market inventory only

oracle.lb_divergence_signal: candidate offline assets rise while leaderboard_proxy or contract validity falls
oracle.scale_change: v4 keeps the runtime-shaped oracle and adds independent domain-randomized screen/confirm suites with tail and worst-case promotion gates

robust_online_planner.information_boundary: bounded public price, crop-yield, and weed observations only
robust_online_planner.objective: mean of two worst scenario returns (CVaR proxy)

rollout.information_boundary: supplied observation only; current prices held constant

reasons: no strict lower-tail or worst-case improvement

terminal_recovery.information_boundary: public step/day/hour, horizon, market quotes, farms, and own private inventory only
terminal_recovery.processing_order: market before workers; town demand before next observation
